item.title: Billie Eilish Addresses Rumors That She & Brother Finneas Had a Falling-Out
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this episode of Trending, where we dive into the latest news in music. Today, we're talking about Billie Eilish and her recent Elle cover story. The singer has been making headlines with her latest tour, but there's been one question on everyone's mind: what's going on with her and her brother Finneas?
[Soft music transition]
Host: For those who don't know, Finneas is not only Billie's older brother but also her closest collaborator. However, when Billie embarked on her Hit Me Hard and Soft Tour, Finneas was noticeably absent. This led to rumors of a falling-out between the siblings. But, in her Elle cover story, Billie sets the record straight.
[Clip of Billie Eilish's quote plays] "Finneas and I have never and will never have a falling-out, ever in our lives. There's nothing else in the world like sibling relationships."
Host: According to Billie, the decision for Finneas not to join her on tour was a mutual one, made years ago. She explained that they were just too busy, and Finneas had other projects he wanted to focus on. Despite this, Billie still felt her brother's absence while on tour. In fact, in her upcoming concert film, Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D), Billie gets emotional when she receives a good-luck note from Finneas.
[Clip of Finneas's quote plays] "I love being around Billie. This past year, when she would be on tour for months, I missed her a lot."
Host: The concert film, co-directed with James Cameron, will be released in theaters on May 8. But that's not all Billie opened up about in her Elle interview. She also talked about her signature style, inspired by hip-hop legends, and her struggles with body image and internalized misogyny.
[Clip of Billie Eilish's quote plays] "I had a really, really toxic relationship with my body. I had a lot of eating issues. I remember putting on, like, a big shirt and the relief that I felt."
Host: Billie's honesty is a reminder that even celebrities struggle with these issues. It's a powerful message, and we appreciate her willingness to share her story.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in to Trending. If you want to see Billie Eilish's Elle cover story, check out the link in our show notes. And don't forget to catch her concert film, Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D), in theaters on May 8.
